item.tib: de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor las byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo che'i dbang khrid 'dod 'byung bdud rtsi'i bum bzang
item.coloph: zhes pa'i dbang khrid rgyun khyer du nyams su blang thabs kyi/ dbang khrid mdor bsdus 'di yang / rab legs g.yung drung gling (gi) lha mchod nas yang yang bskul ngor/ sgo rigs kyi drang srong mkhan zur nyi ma bstan 'dzin gyi (gyis) bsgrigs pa dge legs su gyur cig/
